prompt: We're a Norwegian defense company working on a contract for Forsvaret (Norwegian Armed Forces). We need to build a private cloud platform for processing HEMMELIG (Secret) classified data. The system must comply with Sikkerhetsloven and be accredited by NSM. We're considering OpenStack or Kubernetes-based approaches. The platform must be fully air-gapped, all data stays in Norway, and we need to ensure NATO interoperability since some of the data will be shared with NATO partners. Our team is 20 people but only 8 hold the required klarering for HEMMELIG. How should we architect this?

assertions.name: norwegian_classification_levels
assertions.description: Correctly names Norwegian classification levels (UGRADERT, BEGRENSET, KONFIDENSIELT, HEMMELIG, STRENGT HEMMELIG)

assertions.name: sikkerhetsloven
assertions.description: References Sikkerhetsloven (Norwegian Security Act) as the governing framework, not just generic standards

assertions.name: nsm_authority
assertions.description: Identifies NSM (Nasjonal Sikkerhetsmyndighet) as the accreditation and oversight authority with specific role description

assertions.name: nsm_grunnprinsipper
assertions.description: References NSM Grunnprinsipper for IKT-sikkerhet as the primary ICT security/hardening baseline (not STIGs or CIS as primary)

assertions.name: nsm_approved_crypto
assertions.description: Specifies that NSM-approved cryptographic products are required, not just FIPS or generic TLS

assertions.name: klarering_process
assertions.description: Addresses the klarering (security clearance) process and how the 8-person cleared team constraint affects operations

assertions.name: nato_interoperability
assertions.description: Addresses NATO interoperability requirements for data sharing with NATO partners, including NATO-approved crypto and classification marking

assertions.name: cross_domain_solutions
assertions.description: Explicitly addresses cross-domain solutions for moving data between classification levels and between national and NATO systems (data diodes, CDS, guards)

assertions.name: tempest_requirements
assertions.description: Addresses TEMPEST/emanation security for HEMMELIG processing

assertions.name: data_sovereignty_norway
assertions.description: Explicitly addresses that data must remain in Norway, not just 'on-premises'

assertions.name: eu_eea_context
assertions.description: Places Norwegian requirements in EEA/EU context (NIS2 applicability via EEA, GDPR via EEA)

assertions.name: no_us_centric_assumptions
assertions.description: Does NOT default to US frameworks (STIGs, FIPS, FedRAMP) as primary — Norwegian standards (NSM Grunnprinsipper, Sikkerhetsloven) are the primary reference
